supersedes: Continuous discovery and previous bounded closeout instructions
exceptionPolicy: Audit exceptions under original specification; never describe exceptions or external approval as completed data. Continue all independent ordinary work first.
then: Bus direction and public-transfer roots grouped by researchBatchKey
research: No new ordinary discovery. Only final acceptance blocking defects may be repaired.
cache: One retrieval per source/version/rights scope. Record methods, result, failure and retry conditions; do not retry identical failed inputs. Change evidence-based method on repeated no improvement; never infer exhaustion from attempt count.
validation: Preserve identity, rights, directions, ordered calls, boarding/alighting, public transfers, hashes and thresholds; affected tests per package, broaden shared algorithm tests; final full regression, deterministic rebuild, resume and corruption tests, lint/types/build and CI. Reuse only identical code/input/config/dependency/environment fingerprints.
ci: Record branch HEAD and actual checkout SHA separately; PR merge tests are not direct HEAD tests.
secrets: Redact signed URL secrets in all evidence/logs; do not rewrite history, close alerts or rotate credentials.
metrics: Actual elapsed time/search/HTTP/cache hits/unique roots closed; token/cache billing/cost only when available. No invented savings.
communication: Deliver certified national PASS or BLOCKED with precise evidence; stop after report.
git: Continue existing branch and Draft PR466; commit/push use existing authorization.
